DIAGNOSIS READY: Polymorphous Light Eruption (PMLE).

The chronic, pruritic nature of the rash on sun-exposed areas, exacerbated by heat without systemic symptoms or recent exposures, is highly characteristic of a delayed hypersensitivity reaction to sunlight.
